narration: You are born in a tiny wax cell.
scene: A single bee egg inside a small hexagonal wax cell
label: DAY 0

narration: One of a few hundred boys your mother decided to make this spring.
scene: A honeycomb frame with a few hundred drone cells highlighted
label: A FEW HUNDRED BOYS

narration: Here's the first weird thing about you: you have no father.
scene: A bee egg with a question mark and a family tree missing a branch
label: NO FATHER

narration: Literally. Your mother never bothered to fertilize your egg.
scene: A queen bee laying an egg while ignoring a tiny sperm icon
label: UNFERTILIZED

narration: You came from an egg, all on its own.
scene: A single egg with sparkle lines and no other egg nearby
label: ALL ON ITS OWN

narration: What does that make you? It makes you a drone.
scene: A big round drone bee with the word drone floating
label: A DRONE

narration: Half a family tree. A mother, and a grandfather. Nothing else.
scene: A family tree diagram with only a mother and grandfather
label: HALF A FAMILY TREE

narration: The egg they built you from was unfertilized.
scene: A worker bee examining an egg with a microscope
label: CHECKED

narration: Which is the bee way of saying: this one's going to be a boy.
scene: An egg with a blue baby-boy bow tied on it
label: IT'S A BOY

narration: You take longer to grow than anyone else in the hive.
scene: A drone larva with a slow snail next to it
label: SLOW GROWER

narration: Workers do it in twenty-one days.
scene: A worker bee beside a calendar showing 21 days
label: WORKERS: 21 DAYS

narration: Queens in sixteen. You? Twenty-four.
scene: A queen beside 16 days and a drone beside 24 days on a chart
label: YOU: 24 DAYS

narration: You are the slowest, laziest, biggest baby in the colony.
scene: A big lazy drone larva lounging in its cell
label: LAZIEST BABY

narration: And you eat like it.
scene: A fat drone with a huge fork and a pile of food
label: EAT LIKE IT

narration: You hatch into a world that already has an opinion about you.
scene: A drone crawling out of its cell with other bees staring
label: HATCHED

narration: Congratulations. You're alive. For now.
scene: A newborn drone standing in the hive, dramatic shadow behind it
label: FOR NOW

narration: Here's your first problem. You can't feed yourself.
scene: A drone looking at food with confused eyes and empty hands
label: CAN'T FEED YOURSELF

narration: You don't have the equipment. No pollen baskets, no stinger.
scene: A drone's legs with empty spots where tools should be
label: NO EQUIPMENT

narration: No way to gather food.
scene: A drone trying and failing to pick up a flower
label: NO GATHERING

narration: If a worker doesn't shove nectar into your mouth, you starve.
scene: A worker bee feeding a drone mouth to mouth
label: MOUTH TO MOUTH

narration: So that's your life. You sit in the hive, and the girls feed you.
scene: A drone relaxing on a couch while worker bees serve him
label: SERVED

narration: Mouth to mouth.
scene: Close-up of two bee faces touching, sharing food
label: TROPHALLAXIS

narration: You eat about three times what a worker eats.
scene: A drone with three plates of food beside one tiny worker plate
label: 3X THE FOOD

narration: And you do nothing for it.
scene: A drone napping while workers work hard around him
label: DOING NOTHING

narration: No foraging. No building. No guarding.
scene: A drone shrugging beside a crossed-out flower, comb and shield
label: NO CHORES

narration: You can't even sting.
scene: A drone's rear end with a floppy, useless stinger
label: NO STING

narration: You are, to be completely honest about it, a freeloader.
scene: A drone wearing sunglasses and a hammock, living rent-free
label: FREELOADER

narration: But the hive doesn't kick you out. Not yet.
scene: Worker bees pointing at the door but holding back
label: NOT YET

narration: Because you have one job.
scene: A drone with a single task card held up
label: ONE JOB

narration: One single, terrifying, stupid job.
scene: A drone looking worried at a job description labeled with a heart
label: TERRIFYING JOB

narration: And the whole colony is willing to feed you until you get your chance.
scene: The whole hive cheering while workers keep feeding the drone
label: THEY'LL WAIT

narration: Your job is to mate with a queen.
scene: A drone dreaming of a big queen bee with a crown
label: MATE A QUEEN

narration: That's it. That's the entire reason you exist.
scene: A drone pointing at a checklist with one single line on it
label: ONE REASON

narration: You are a flying delivery system for sperm, and nothing else.
scene: A drone with a tiny mail package, flying through the sky
label: DELIVERY SYSTEM

narration: You spend your days warm, and fed, and useless.
scene: A drone cozy and warm inside the hive, doing nothing
label: WARM AND USELESS

narration: And somewhere outside, waiting for you,
scene: A drone looking out the hive entrance at the big sky
label: OUTSIDE

narration: Is the most crowded singles bar in the insect world.
scene: Hundreds of drones buzzing around a neon sign in the sky
label: SINGLES BAR

narration: When you're about a week old, you start flying.
scene: A young drone flapping its wings for the first time
label: FIRST FLIGHT

narration: You leave the hive.
scene: A drone flying out of the hive entrance into the open air
label: LEAVING

narration: And you head for a place called a drone congregation area.
scene: A drone flying toward a distant gathering of bees in the sky
label: CONGREGATION AREA

narration: No one is entirely sure how you find it. You just do.
scene: A drone shrugging with a map and a question mark
label: HOW?

narration: It's high in the sky, above the treeline.
scene: Bees gathered high above a line of trees in the sky
label: ABOVE THE TREES

narration: And it's packed. Hundreds of drones. Sometimes thousands.
scene: A huge crowd of drones buzzing in the sky
label: THOUSANDS

narration: Males from dozens of different colonies.
scene: Drones with little flags from different hives all mixed together
label: STRANGERS

narration: All of you flying in circles.
scene: Drones flying in a big circle pattern in the sky
label: CIRCLES

narration: All of you waiting for the same thing. A queen.
scene: Every drone looking up with hopeful eyes at the sky
label: WAITING

narration: Queens are rare.
scene: A single queen silhouette far away in the sky
label: RARE

narration: A hive makes maybe a handful in a whole year.
scene: A hive with only a few tiny queen symbols coming out of it
label: A HANDFUL A YEAR

narration: And each one mates only once in her life.
scene: A queen with a single checkmark over her whole life timeline
label: ONCE IN HER LIFE

narration: On a single flight.
scene: A queen taking off on one solitary flight
label: ONE FLIGHT

narration: She'll take about a dozen males. Maybe twenty.
scene: A queen surrounded by twelve to twenty little drone icons
label: A DOZEN WINNERS

narration: So do the math. Thousands of you. One queen.
scene: Thousands of drones on one side, one queen on the other
label: THE MATH

narration: A dozen winners.
scene: A podium with a dozen drones holding little trophies
label: A DOZEN

narration: The rest of you will die waiting.
scene: A huge crowd of drones with sad faces, waiting forever
label: THE REST

narration: Most drones never mate. Never even get close.
scene: A drone watching another drone win while it stays behind
label: NEVER MATE

narration: You will spend your whole life flying in circles.
scene: A drone flying the same circle over and over with motion lines
label: CIRCLES

narration: Watching for a queen who will probably never come.
scene: A drone scanning an empty sky with a magnifying glass
label: PROBABLY NEVER

narration: But you keep flying. Because what else is there?
scene: A tired drone still flying with a determined face
label: KEEP FLYING

narration: You are a lottery ticket with wings.
scene: A drone with lottery ticket numbers printed on its wings
label: LOTTERY TICKET

narration: And then, one afternoon, she appears.
scene: A queen bee flying into view against a bright sun
label: SHE APPEARS

narration: You feel her before you see her.
scene: A drone with little heart lines radiating toward a distant queen
label: YOU FEEL HER

narration: Pheromones hit the air.
scene: Invisible scent waves spreading from the queen through the sky
label: PHEROMONES

narration: And every drone in the sky loses his mind at once.
scene: Every drone wide-eyed and crazed, all at the same moment
label: CHAOS

narration: The chase is on.
scene: Drones chasing the queen in a wild race through the sky
label: THE CHASE

narration: She's fast, and she flies high.
scene: The queen flying high above the rest of the drones
label: FAST AND HIGH

narration: She is not going to make this easy.
scene: The queen looking back with a sly smile while drones struggle
label: NOT EASY

narration: Because only the strongest, fastest drones are allowed to catch her.
scene: Only a few strong drones keeping up with the queen
label: ONLY THE STRONG

narration: It's evolution's way of sorting the best genes from the rest.
scene: A giant hand sorting bees into two groups: best and rest
label: SORTING GENES

narration: If you're fast enough, you catch her. You latch on.
scene: A drone catching the queen in mid-air and holding on
label: YOU CATCH HER

narration: And for two to five seconds, you've done the one thing you were born to do.
scene: The drone and queen together with a tiny stopwatch reading seconds
label: 2-5 SECONDS

narration: And then it kills you.
scene: The drone's happy face turning to sudden shock
label: IT KILLS YOU

narration: On the moment of finishing, a part of you is ripped out.
scene: A body part tearing away from the drone mid-flight
label: RIPPED OUT

narration: Roughly the size of your own abdomen.
scene: The drone comparing the size of its abdomen to the lost part
label: ABDOMEN-SIZED

narration: It tears away and stays inside her.
scene: The lost part staying with the queen while the drone falls
label: STAYS INSIDE HER

narration: There's a pop, so loud that beekeepers can hear it from the ground.
scene: A loud POP symbol bursting beside the falling drone
label: POP

narration: You go limp. You fall out of the sky.
scene: A limp drone tumbling down out of the sky
label: FALLING

narration: You're dead before you hit the grass.
scene: The drone falling toward the grass below, eyes closed
label: DEAD BEFORE LANDING

narration: But hey. You won.
scene: A tiny victory flag planted on the fallen drone
label: YOU WON

narration: Most of you never get that moment.
scene: Crowds of drones still waiting in the sky, none of them winning
label: MOST NEVER

narration: And if you don't mate, the colony has a different plan for you.
scene: Workers huddled together whispering and pointing at a drone
label: PLAN B

narration: All summer, the workers tolerate you. They feed you.
scene: Workers feeding a happy drone through the summer
label: ALL SUMMER

narration: They clean up after you. They pretend you matter.
scene: Workers tidying up around a lounging drone
label: PRETENDING

narration: But the whole time, the hive is doing math.
scene: A bee with an abacus counting food against mouths
label: DOING MATH

narration: Every mouth it feeds through winter is food it can't spare.
scene: A scale balancing food against hungry bee mouths
label: NOT ENOUGH FOOD

narration: And then autumn comes.
scene: Leaves falling and the hive entrance looking colder
label: AUTUMN

narration: One day, the feeding stops. No warning.
scene: A worker turning away from a hungry drone with crossed arms
label: FEEDING STOPS

narration: The workers just stop bringing you food.
scene: An empty plate in front of a confused hungry drone
label: NO FOOD

narration: You sit there, getting hungrier.
scene: A drone holding its growling empty stomach
label: HUNGRY

narration: And you start to understand: you are now a liability.
scene: A drone with a big warning label stuck on it
label: LIABILITY

narration: Then they come for you.
scene: Several worker bees marching toward the drone together
label: THEY COME

narration: Workers grab you.
scene: Worker bees grabbing the drone with their legs
label: GRABBED

narration: They bite your wings.
scene: A worker biting down on the drone's wing
label: WINGS BITTEN

narration: And they drag you toward the entrance.
scene: Workers dragging a struggling drone across the hive floor
label: DRAGGED

narration: You struggle. It doesn't matter.
scene: The drone struggling while the workers hold firm
label: IT DOESN'T MATTER

narration: They shove you out the door, into the cold.
scene: The drone being pushed out the hive entrance into cold air
label: OUT THE DOOR

narration: And here's the cruel part. You can't feed yourself.
scene: The drone alone outside looking at flowers it can't use
label: THE CRUEL PART

narration: You never learned. You were born dependent.
scene: The drone as a baby being fed, then alone as an adult
label: BORN DEPENDENT

narration: And now you've been fired.
scene: A drone holding a tiny pink slip of paper
label: FIRED

narration: You sit on the cold ground outside the hive.
scene: A drone sitting alone on the cold ground by the hive
label: OUTSIDE

narration: And you wait to die.
scene: The drone shivering alone under a grey sky
label: WAIT TO DIE

narration: You don't last long out there.
scene: A frozen drone with icicles on its antennae
label: NOT LONG

narration: Drones are terrible at cold.
scene: A drone shivering hard with blue lips
label: TERRIBLE AT COLD

narration: Tests show a few hours near freezing kills three quarters of you.
scene: A chart showing three of four drones frozen and one alive
label: 3 OF 4 DIE

narration: While workers don't even notice.
scene: Workers warm inside the hive while a drone freezes outside
label: WORKERS DON'T NOTICE

narration: So you freeze. Or you starve. Or a bird eats you.
scene: Three fates drawn: a snowflake, an empty plate, a bird
label: PICK YOUR ENDING

narration: Take your pick.
scene: A drone shrugging among the three fate symbols
label: TAKE YOUR PICK

narration: Either way, your story ends the same way it began.
scene: A loop arrow from a tiny egg to a fallen drone
label: SAME AS IT BEGAN

narration: Alone, on the ground, a few feet from the only home you ever knew.
scene: A drone on the ground, the warm hive glowing just out of reach
label: SO CLOSE TO HOME

narration: And the hive? The hive is fine.
scene: The hive warm and happy, bees dancing inside
label: THE HIVE IS FINE

narration: The workers settle in for winter, warm and fed, and they don't think about you again.
scene: Workers cozy in the hive with full honeycombs
label: WARM AND FED

narration: You were never really one of them. You were an investment.
scene: A drone silhouette separate from the hive, a dollar sign on it
label: AN INVESTMENT

narration: In the spring, your mother will lay more of you, and they'll live your exact same life. Eat, wait, fly, and die.
scene: New drone eggs being laid in spring, a circle of life drawn
label: THE CYCLE

narration: Thanks for watching. If you enjoyed this, consider subscribing.
scene: A drone waving with one little arm beside a subscribe button
label: SUBSCRIBE

narration: And next time you see a bee, remember: if it's a boy, it's just waiting for its one shot — or for winter to come.
scene: A male drone bee sitting still with a timer, watching the sky
label: THE CLOCK IS RUNNING
